items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.
Experience in payroll and/or personnel processing and/or related administrative skills.
University of California payroll personnel system (UCPath) training and experience.\

Under the general supervision of the Human Resources Director, this position is responsible for the administration and implementation of departmental personnel services in the Arts Division. The incumbent works independently and as a cooperative member of the departmental administrative support staff team, and is responsible for collaborating with departments and other campus units to deliver efficient and effective personnel services and ensure compliance with policy and procedures.
Demonstrated commitment to creating an inclusive community that fosters access, openness, and productive engagement for all.
Familiarity with University of California academic personnel and payroll policies and procedures.
Familiarity with other campus systems such as InfoView, Glacier, CruzPay, DivData
Outstanding organizational skills with strict attention to detail and ability to retain information.
Demonstrated critical thinking skills to address moderately complex issues and present nuanced analyses; demonstrated ability to apply knowledge, analyze and interpret policies and regulations.
Thorough knowledge of common computer application programs and the Google suite with demonstrated ability using spreadsheet and database software, and ability to learn new
Strong written communication skills with the ability to proofread with a great deal of accuracy.
Demonstrated ability to coordinate a variety of projects simultaneously under the pressure of deadlines and high volume of work.
Demonstrated ability to exercise good judgment and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information and materials.\
Ability to work with a high degree of independence, closely adhering to directions, policies, and procedures, while concurrently maintaining a commitment to teamwork.\
Math skills sufficient to calculate salary and effort percentages, apply rounding methodologies, apply quarterly hour basis time reporting, and reconcile leave accruals.
